mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TOKEN, REG_GB, RATIO_NO, TN.TASK_CD, TN.PROC_CD, NTAX_TRGET_CD, NTAX_WHO, NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD, -- 신규등록인 경우 차량번호 REQ_CAR_NO CASE WHEN TS.WORK_CD = '010' THEN TN.REQ_CAR_NO ELSE TS.CAR_NO END AS CAR_NO, -- 비과세 대상자인 경우 사인 페이지로 이동 CASE WHEN TRIM(TN.NTAX_TRGET_CD) = '00' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS SIGN_YN, (SELECT pkg_common.fn_decrypt(MPHONE_NO) FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE LOGIN_ID = TS.MEMBER_ID ) AS MANAGER_TEL FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND TOKEN = #{TOKEN}
